2.text: Batangira kumurega bati “Uyu twamubonye agandisha ubwoko bwacu, ababuza guha Kayisari umusoro, avuga kandi ko ari Kristo Umwami.”

3.text: Pilato aramubaza ati “Ni wowe mwami w'Abayuda?”Aramusubiza ati “Wakabimenye.”

4.text: Pilato abwira abatambyi bakuru na rubanda ati “Nta cyaha mbonye kuri uyu muntu.”

5.text: Na bo barashega bati “Agomesha abantu, yigisha i Yudaya hose uhereye i Galilaya ukageza n'ino.”

6.text: Pilato abyumvise abaza ko ari Umunyagalilaya.

7.text: Amenye ko ari uwo mu gihugu cya Herode, amwohereza kwa Herode kuko na we yari i Yerusalemu muri iyo minsi.

8.text: Herode abonye Yesu aranezerwa cyane, kuko uhereye kera yashakaga kumubona, kuko yumvaga inkuru ze kandi yifuzaga kubona ikimenyetso yakora.

9.text: Amubaza amagambo menshi, ariko ntiyagira icyo amusubiza.

10.text: Abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi barahagarara, bakomeza kumurega cyane.

11.text: Herode n'abasirikare be baramunegura, baramushinyagurira, maze bamwambika umwenda ubengerana bamugarurira Pilato.

12.text: Herode na Pilato baherako buzura uwo munsi, kuko mbere banganaga.

13.text: Pilato ateranya abatambyi bakuru n'abatware n'abantu bose,

14.text: arababwira ati “Mwanzaniye uyu muntu ngo yagandishije abantu, none dore ubwanjye namubarije imbere yanyu, nyamara nta cyaha mbonye kuri we mu byo mwamureze.

15.text: Ndetse Herode na we nta cyo yabonye kuko yamutugaruriye, kandi dore nta cyo yakoze gikwiriye kumwicisha.

17.text: Ibyo yabivugiye kuko yabaga akwiriye kubabohorera imbohe imwe, mu minsi mikuru yose.]

18.text: Ariko bose basakuriza icyarimwe bati “Kuraho uyu, utubohorere Baraba.”

19.text: Uwo bari bamushyize mu nzu y'imbohe, bamuhora ubugome n'ubwicanyi bwari mu murwa.

20.text: Pilato yongera kuvugana na bo, ashaka kubohora Yesu.

22.text: Ababaza ubwa gatatu ati “Kuki? Uyu yakoze cyaha ki? Simubonyeho icyaha cyo kumwicisha. Nuko nimara kumukubita, ndamubohora.”

23.text: Ariko baramukoranira basakuza n'amajwi arenga, bamuhata ko Yesu abambwa, amajwi yabo aramuganza.

24.text: Nuko Pilato aca urubanza ngo icyo bashaka bagihabwe:

25.text: abohora uwashyizwe mu nzu y'imbohe bamuhora ubugome n'ubwicanyi, uwo bashakaga, maze atanga Yesu ngo bamugire uko bashaka.

26.text: Baramujyana, batangīra umuntu witwaga Simoni w'Umunyakurene waturukaga imusozi, bamukorera umusaraba ngo awikorere akurikiye Yesu.

27.text: Abantu benshi baramukurikira, barimo n'abagore bikubita mu bituza bamuborogera.

28.text: Yesu arabakebuka arababwira ati “Bakobwa b'i Yerusalemu, ntimundirire, ahubwo mwiririre n'abana banyu,

29.text: kuko iminsi izaza bazavuga bati ‘Hahirwa ingumba n'inda zitabyaye, n'amabere atonkeje.’

30.text: Ni bwo bazatangira kubwira imisozi bati ‘Nimutugwire’, babwire n'udusozi bati ‘Nimudutwikire.’

31.text: Mbese ubwo bagenje batya igiti kikiri kibisi, nikimara kuma bizacura iki?”

32.text: Kandi bajyana n'abandi babiri bari inkozi z'ibibi, ngo babīcane na we.

33.text: Nuko bageze ahitwa i Nyabihanga, bamubambanaho n'abo bagome, umwe iburyo bwe n'undi ibumoso.

34.text: Yesu aravuga ati “Data, ubababarire kuko batazi icyo bakora.”Bagabana imyenda ye barayifindira.

35.text: Abantu barahagarara bareba. Abatware na bo baramukoba cyane bati “Yakijije abandi, ngaho na we niyikize niba ari we Kristo watoranijwe n'Imana.”

36.text: Abasirikare na bo baramushinyagurira, bamwegereye bamuha inzoga isharira

38.text: Hejuru ye hari urwandiko rwanditswe ngo “UYU NI UMWAMI W'ABAYUDA.”

39.text: Umwe muri abo bagome babambwe aramutuka ati “Si wowe Kristo? Ngaho ikize natwe udukize.”

40.text: Ariko uwa kabiri amusubiza amucyaha ati “No kūbaha Imana ntuyubaha, uri mu rubanza rumwe n'urwe?

41.text: Twebweho duhowe ukuri, tukaba twituwe ibihwanye n'ibyo twakoze, ariko uyu nta kibi yakoze.”

42.text: Nuko abwira Yesu ati “Mwami, uzanyibuke ubwo uzazira mu bwami bwawe.”

43.text: Aramusubiza ati “Ndakubwira ukuri, yuko uyu munsi turi bubane muri Paradiso.”

44.text: Nuko isaha zibaye nk'esheshatu, haza ubwirakabiri mu gihugu cyose kugeza ku isaa cyenda,

45.text: izuba ntiryava, umwenda ukingiriza Ahera cyane h'urusengero utabukamo kabiri.

46.text: Yesu avuga ijwi rirenga ati “Data, mu maboko yawe ni ho nshyize ubugingo bwanjye.” Amaze kuvuga atyo umwuka urahera.

47.text: Nuko umutware w'abasirikare abonye ibibaye ahimbaza Imana ati “Ni ukuri uyu muntu yari umukiranutsi.”

48.text: Inteko z'abantu bari bateraniye aho kurebēra, babonye ibibaye basubirayo bīkubita mu bituza.

49.text: N'incuti ze zose n'abagore bavanye i Galilaya, bari bahagaze kure babireba.

50.text: Umuntu witwaga Yosefu, yari umujyanama wo mu Bayuda, w'umunyangeso nziza kandi ukiranuka.

51.text: Uwo ntiyafatanije n'inama zabo n'ibyo bakoze, yari Umunyarimataya, umudugudu w'Abayuda, na we yategerezaga ubwami bw'Imana.

52.text: Nuko ajya kwa Pilato asaba intumbi ya Yesu.

53.text: Arayibambūra ayizingira mu mwenda w'igitare, ayihamba mu mva yakorogoshowe mu rutare, itarahambwamo umuntu.

54.text: Hāri ku munsi wo Kwitegura, isabato yenda gusohora.

55.text: Nuko abagore bavanye na Yesu i Galilaya bamukurikiye, babona imva n'intumbi ye uko ihambwe,

56.text: basubirayo batunganya ibihumura neza n'imibavu.Kandi ku munsi w'isabato bararuhuka nk'uko byategetswe.
